definitions.explanation: A laundry product that softens clothes and reduces static electricity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I add fabric softener when doing laundry.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This fabric softener has a nice scent.

examples.japanese: {柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Towels become fluffy when you use fabric softener.

notes:
{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい} is fabric softener. Formation: ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧ 'soft, pliable' + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ 'agent, preparation' — the same suffix as in ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ and ⟦{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}→漂白剤：07035_hyouhakuzai⟧.

It goes into a separate compartment from the detergent and is released during the rinse, so it is not mixed in at the start of the wash.

Collocations:
- {柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add fabric softener
- {柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: the scent of fabric softener — a heavily marketed selling point in Japan
- ⟦{無香料|むこうりょう}→無香料：15796_mukouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}: unscented fabric softener
